statements.text:
I know what you’re thinking…

This video must be AI, but it’s not.  

This is Barack Obama on border security and illegal immigration.  

Before Democrats masterminded the most historic illegal invasion in history, they talked tough on limiting illegal immigration and the impact of it on American workers.

What changed?

The remarks out of the White House today are like something out of a dystopian movie.  

The American people have watched Joe Biden’s mental deterioration in real time for four years.  He’s using the short stairs on Air Force One for God’s sake.  

Biden is not fit for this job anymore and what we’re witnessing is not some Russian bot farm making AI deep fakes of Biden.  

I would expect the media to push back on this just a bit more considering the White House Press Secretary just accused all of them of sharing fake videos of the President.

When two of the most influential figures in the world—one a groundbreaking tech genius, the other a powerful leader of a political movement and former President—are discussing the future on equal footing, it’s time to take notice. 

Imagine having the knowledge and insight to engage in deep conversations about energy, AI, and economic development without needing a team of experts to brief you. 

Could Kamala do this?  
Absolutely NOT.

Most Democrat politicians wouldn’t even know where to start. 

Trump and Musk are proving that real leadership means being ready to tackle the big issues head-on.

American History was made tonight on X.

Kamala Harris told Dana Bash, “my values have not changed.”

The following receipts are not AI generated.  

The internet is forever. 

And Kamala Harris has no values, because the only thing she believes in is power and saying anything to keep it. https://t.co/0qTqgmgueM

AI data centers next to energy-producing places where the land is cheaper and there is an abundance of extra natural gas to power it — I think it’s a great idea. At the federal level, let’s reduce regulation to make that easier.

statements.text: The rise of artificial intelligence is inevitable, and there is no turning back.
